options.content:
This dashboard defaults to the durable cluster nodes (`optiplex` and `ovh-*`); `wyrm2` and roaming nodes are intentionally outside the default node selector. The HDD/SSD split uses the exported Kubernetes node label `storage.allegedly.works/tier`, surfaced by kube-state-metrics as `label_storage_allegedly_works_tier`.

Physical device panels show block-device writes. Container panels show cAdvisor filesystem writes. SeaweedFS, Loki, and Mimir panels show logical traffic or ingestion at those services. These layers overlap and must not be added together as one Sankey total. Rate panels use an explicit 5-minute window so the same PromQL and LogQL remain valid in dashboard rendering and Explore.

panels.title: HDD write throughput
panels.description: Physical writes observed by node-exporter on cluster nodes labelled storage tier hdd.

targets.expr: sum by (node, device) (((rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr).*"}[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"})) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="hdd"})))

panels.title: SSD write throughput
panels.description: Physical writes observed by node-exporter on cluster nodes labelled storage tier ssd.

targets.expr: sum by (node, device) (((rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr).*"}[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"})) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="ssd"})))

panels.title: HDD write IOPS
panels.description: Completed physical write operations per second on HDD-tier nodes.

targets.expr: sum by (node, device) (((rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr).*"}[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"})) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="hdd"})))

panels.title: SSD write IOPS
panels.description: Completed physical write operations per second on SSD-tier nodes.

targets.expr: sum by (node, device) (((rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr).*"}[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"})) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="ssd"})))

panels.title: HDD busy fraction
panels.description: Fraction of wall time for which HDD devices had I/O in flight. Values near 1 mean the device is continuously busy.

targets.expr: sum by (node, device) (((rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr).*"}[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"})) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="hdd"})))

panels.title: SSD busy fraction
panels.description: Fraction of wall time for which SSD devices had I/O in flight.

targets.expr: sum by (node, device) (((rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr).*"}[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"})) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="ssd"})))

panels.title: Top HDD container writers
panels.description: cAdvisor filesystem writes grouped by namespace, pod, container, node, and device. This is the best current producer attribution, but is not a physical-block-device conservation total.

targets.expr: topk(${topk}, sum by (namespace, pod, container, node, device) (rate(container_fs_writes_bytes_total{namespace!="", pod!="", container!="", container!="POD", node=~"$node"}[5m]) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="hdd"})))

panels.title: Top SSD container writers
panels.description: cAdvisor filesystem writes grouped by namespace, pod, container, node, and device.

targets.expr: topk(${topk}, sum by (namespace, pod, container, node, device) (rate(container_fs_writes_bytes_total{namespace!="", pod!="", container!="", container!="POD", node=~"$node"}[5m]) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="ssd"})))

panels.title: Top HDD container write IOPS
panels.description: cAdvisor filesystem write operations per second grouped by namespace, pod, container, node, and device.

targets.expr: topk(${topk}, sum by (namespace, pod, container, node, device) (rate(container_fs_writes_total{namespace!="", pod!="", container!="", container!="POD", node=~"$node"}[5m]) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="hdd"})))

panels.title: Top SSD container write IOPS
panels.description: cAdvisor filesystem write operations per second grouped by namespace, pod, container, node, and device.

targets.expr: topk(${topk}, sum by (namespace, pod, container, node, device) (rate(container_fs_writes_total{namespace!="", pod!="", container!="", container!="POD", node=~"$node"}[5m]) * on (node) group_left () max by (node, label_storage_allegedly_works_tier) (kube_node_labels{node=~"$node", label_storage_allegedly_works_tier="ssd"})))

panels.title: SeaweedFS S3 received by bucket
panels.description: Logical bytes received by SeaweedFS S3, broken down by bucket. This is ingress to SeaweedFS and is not the same as physical disk writes.

panels.title: SeaweedFS S3 sent by bucket
panels.description: Logical bytes sent by SeaweedFS S3, broken down by bucket.

panels.title: Loki log bytes by namespace
panels.description: Logical log volume accepted by Loki, grouped by namespace.

panels.title: Loki log bytes by pod
panels.description: Logical log volume accepted by Loki, grouped by namespace and pod.

panels.title: Scraped samples/s by target
panels.description: Estimated samples/s per scrape target, derived from the per-scrape sample count over five minutes. Shows only the selected top rows; this pre-ingestion estimate does not include direct OTLP or Tempo metrics-generator writes counted by Mimir.

targets.expr: topk(${topk}, sum by (job, namespace, service, instance) (sum_over_time(scrape_samples_post_metric_relabeling{job!=""}[5m]) / 300))

panels.title: Mimir samples/s
panels.description: Samples accepted by Mimir's distributor for the anonymous tenant, including scrape and direct-write sources. Rejected and deduplicated samples are excluded, so this is not expected to equal the scrape-target estimate.

panels.title: Scraped samples/s
panels.description: Estimated average rate from per-scrape sample counts over five minutes, across all scrape targets. Excludes direct OTLP and Tempo metrics-generator writes sent to Mimir.
